main_measure.name: t of mean (72-bar forward excess return x forecast/10), non-overlapping grid, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm t >= 2 with supporting check passing; reject t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess 72-bar return of cells with forecast above median positive forecast minus that of zero-forecast cells

decided_by: The main measure has t >= 2 and the top-half minus zero-forecast excess return is > 0 (confirm rule).
reading: The drift is each coin's mean 72-bar return over the non-overlapping grid of all its windows; the median of positive forecasts is taken over all pooled grid cells with a positive forecast; the plan's 'fewer than 200 cases' rule is treated as a minimum count giving 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
